From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Subject: CSA artifact reconciliation & sample log request

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for starting the CAIQ intake. We're running a short artifact reconciliation to map your responses to our control owners and to collect a small set of representative evidence samples so your review window stays tight. Two quick asks from our side:

1) Can you confirm which controls you marked as "in-scope (managed by vendor)" vs "customer managed" in the attached matrix? If you can re-send the filled matrix (we prefer the XLSX export), that will speed mapping.

2) For a subset of 10 controls we've prioritized (listed in the attached PDF), can you share one example artifact each: either a screenshot, an exported log (redacted), or a short config snippet. Approximate examples: access control policy, 90-day access log extract, VPC peering diagram, encryption-at-rest KMS key ARN. If you need a sample schema for logs we included the CSV template.

I've attached: evidence_request_CSAQ_20261130.pdf (asks + owner table) and artifact_index_export.csv (template).

Target timeline: if NovusHealth can return the filled matrix and at least 4 sample artifacts by next Wednesday (2026-12-07) we can complete the first pass before your SOC vendor arrives. If that timeline is tight, tell us which controls are blocked and we'll propose staggered checkpoints.

Thanks — looping in Irene (controls mapping) and Marcus (logs owner) for owner assignment and any follow-ups.

Best,

Jonas Weber
Head of Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments: evidence_request_CSAQ_20261130.pdf (PDF), artifact_index_export.csv (CSV)

Jonas —

Thanks for the clear asks. Please find attached our current CAIQ export; we filled the in-scope flags but flagged a couple of items "clarify" where we think the provider/vendor split needs discussion (marked in column G).

I attached: Novus_CSAQ_matrix_filled.xlsx and a small access log sample (access_log_sample_202610.zip) that contains redacted lines for control CCM-AC-01 and CCM-IM-04.

Two clarifications:
- Our security team prefers that you reference the log extract patterns, not full PII-bearing logs. The ZIP contains redaction.txt showing the redaction pattern we used.
- For encryption-at-rest we can provide the KMS key metadata but not the full key ARN in the package; we can provide a short read-only KMS export if necessary.

Happy to hop on a 30-min call if you want to walk through the matrix line-by-line — we have availability Wed 2026-12-02 10:00-12:00 ET.

Best,

Sarah Park
Security Compliance Manager
NovusHealth
sarah.park@novushealth.com

Attachments: Novus_CSAQ_matrix_filled.xlsx (XLSX), access_log_sample_202610.zip (ZIP)
